## v1.1.1 (2026-11-23)

The published course site now opens the full course book.

- Restored the course navigation, weekly essentials, assignment checklist, and reading pages at the course website address.
- Kept all course content, assignment dates, and grading requirements unchanged.

## v1.1.0

- Added seven short essentials guides with 20–30 minutes of weekly preparation; retained every full chapter as an optional reference.
- Organized two weekly sessions around Prepare, Teach One Another, and Ponder and Prove, with specific instruction and peer activities.
- Added a complete assignment checklist and Saturday sprint dates. Sprint 1's plan stays in the first class; Sprint 6 ends April 3.
- Published proposed midterm and final exam windows, limited exam scope to essentials and explicitly taught class material, and retained all grading weights and optional extra credit.
- Updated weekly navigation and the downloadable starter to match. Meeting days, times, and exam delivery remain unconfirmed.

## v1.0.0

- Organized the full course into seven weeks for BYU-Idaho, Winter 2027 Second Block, February 22–April 8.
- Listed Rob Teigen as Professor and Kyle Matheson as Teaching Assistant. Unknown course details, exact deadlines, and institutional policy text remain blank.
- Retained all readings, learning outcomes, six sprints, peer testing, both exams, rubrics, and the 450-point grading model.
- Made Codex the primary tool and Claude a supported alternative, with local starter files and shared workflows.
- Preserved the original tracked source and its release history in an archive excluded from the course site. See [Credits](99-credits.qmd).
